design.instruct: A seventeen-year-old Indian boy, male baritone teenage voice, calm and expressive, speaking English with a soft Indian accent, clear pronunciation, conversational narration.
design.note: Designing again with this text gives a SIMILAR voice, not the identical one. For the exact voice, always clone reference.wav (below).

reproduce.ref_text: My parents gave me pocket money, and by Wednesday itself, it was gone. When I think about where I spent it? On Monday, I bought chips during recess.
